collection.title: Renault Arkana 2020 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit the Renault Arkana 2020 Onwards which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Hook Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this model, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
